stories.title: Ranking the 10 best College Football Playoff games
stories.summary: Who takes the No. 1 spot? ESPN's Bill Connelly lists out his top 10 College Football Playoff games.

stories.title: Giants QB Dart to have knee surgery, miss rest of regular season
stories.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will undergo surgery on his knee and miss the rest of the regular season, though head coach John Harbaugh didn't rule out the possibility Dart would return if the Giants were to make the playoffs.

stories.title: Judge says he intends to be available for G1 of Wild Card series
stories.summary: Yankees' slugger Aaron Judge told ESPN on Wednesday that he intends to be ready for Game 1 of the AL Wild Card Series at Yankee Stadium next Tuesday.

stories.title: Sources: Extension talks between Knicks, Towns at standstill
stories.summary: Extension talks have stagnated between the Knicks and Karl-Anthony Towns, and an agreement is considered unlikely as the team begins camp, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Seahawks coach apologizes to Payton for comments: 'Lesson learned'
stories.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.
